id: title:Gilbert09:skip issue on persistent tags endpoint server error

review.posthog_relevance: Resilience of warehouse ingestion pipeline against transient server errors on metadata fetching, allowing partial ingestion rather than complete failure.
review.reason: Adds a helper function to skip issue tag fetching on HTTP 5xx errors while preserving successfully retrieved rows, supporting warehouse ingestion continuity.
review.uncertainty: End-to-end warehouse ingestion path and parent issue fetching implementation are not demonstrated in this chunk; benefit relies on unverified parent issue and ingestion entry point.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the parent issue fetching or the warehouse ingestion entry point, so while the skip behavior and its test are clear, the complete end-to-end path and its relationship to warehouse ingestion is not demonstrated. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new helper function _skip_issue_on_tags_server_error that catches HTTP 5xx errors while iterating an issue's tags and returns early, while still yielding any successfully retrieved rows before the error.
observations.posthog_connection: This could allow the warehouse ingestion pipeline to continue processing other issues or values even when a specific issue's tags endpoint returns a persistent server error, rather than failing the entire warehouse ingestion job.
